tiles.title: The Mica Fountain
tiles.brief: A public glitter fountain on a broad Kowloon textile mill footprint. A restrained silver-blue ceramic basin and a single copper nozzle at its open crown launch a spray of fine mica flakes carried downwind. Keep the mouth of the nozzle distinctly visible near the roof centre; leave most of the air clear for animation. The lower building is a hollow fluted stone drum split by a deep gallery; collectors can walk behind the polished trough. Prioritise one clear silhouette and a credible load path. Use two dominant materials and one accent; leave broad planes quiet. Keep roof planes aligned with the supplied polygon and front wall feet on its edges. A few local marks communicate human use. No unrelated machinery, arcades or gardens; treat the named references as drawing examples only.

tiles.title: The Highwire Exchange
tiles.brief: A tightrope-walking school in the air. Two unequal vermilion masonry pylons lean inward above a deep public court. One taut cable with a barely perceptible loaded sag joins anchored eyelets between projecting launch decks. A tiny lone walker balances midway with a transverse pole. The negative space under the wire is the subject. Show exactly where the anchor loads return through buttresses to the occupied plinth. Prioritise one clear silhouette and a credible load path. Use two dominant materials and one accent; leave broad planes quiet. Keep roof planes aligned with the supplied polygon and front wall feet on its edges. A few local marks communicate human use. No unrelated machinery, arcades or gardens; treat the named references as drawing examples only.
